QuestInfo.name: Honor of the Dragon
QuestInfo.1: #p1013000# wants to give #bBattle Mode#k a try. #p1013000# should be satisfied if you achieve #bRank 9#... Talk to #b#p9070004##k in any city to join Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.2: #p1013000# was pleased to reach Rank 9. If you ever want to give him some more exercise, you should aim for a higher rank.

0.1: Huh? What do you mean? Come on, I don't want to miss out! Let's give it a try! Can we? Can we?\r\n#L0##bDo we have to?#l\n#k
0.2: Come oooon! I wanna show everybody how powerful an Onyx Dragon really is! Pleeease? Let's go! Okay?\r\n#L0##bOkay, fine! But we'll just do it until we reach Rank 9, okay?#l\n#k
0.3: All right! Yeah! I'm gonna join in Battle Mode, I'm gonna join Battle Mode! We'll kick butt! Let's go, let's go!

yes.0: We have to talk to some guy named #b#p9070004# in town#k to join Battle Mode. Let's go!

1.0: We did it! Battle Mode Rank 9! Yeah! Aren't you excited? Of course you're excited!

yes.0: Let's do it again! I bet we can get an even higher rank this time!

npc.0: Is #bRank 9#k really that hard to get...? I'm an Onyx Dragon... I'm not that weak, am I? No, we can't give up! We just have to go see #b#p9070004# in town#k...
